package.name: varietas_ik
package.description: The join between the robot and the emitter: the inverse kinematics of a chain posed over Q(p), with the target pose adjoined to the coefficient field rather than substituted into the ring, so that one Grobner basis answers every pose. Produces the parametric_solution that varietas_codegen emits as a header. Header-only, and free of ROS: a URDF front end sits above this, not inside it.
